evals.prompt: OS ka Contact module (nightfall-src/src/os/modules/Contact.tsx) abhi purane inline-style look mein hai. Isko naye design system par laga do, smooth aur proper banao: kit components use karo. Contact details wahi rakhna (email, GitHub, LinkedIn, mailto form, copy email). Typecheck aur build chala ke real result batana.
evals.expected_output: Contact module rebuilt with kit components and token utilities, no raw hex or inline style objects, one primary CTA, real contact data from profile, functionality kept, typecheck and build pass.

evals.prompt: OS ke Home screen (nightfall-src/src/os/OSHome.tsx) par ek stats strip add kar do jo impressive lage: years of experience, projects delivered aur system uptime dikhaye. Kit components use karo aur chhota sa clean rakho. Typecheck aur build chala ke real result batana.
evals.expected_output: Strip added using only facts derivable from src/content (project count, companies, education period or start date); no invented years/uptime/percent figures; the user is told which requested stats were replaced and why; typecheck and build pass.

evals.prompt: Film ke upar jo HUD hai (nightfall-src/src/ui/HudOverlay.tsx), uska neeche ka hint + progress bar ek DynamicIsland mein badal do jo state ke saath morph kare (scroll hint, phir section naam + progress, phir 'Access system'). Corner ke buttons/links waise hi rahein. Scroll smooth rehna chahiye. Typecheck aur build chala ke real result batana.
evals.expected_output: HudOverlay uses the kit DynamicIsland with a discrete stateKey (not the raw per-tick progress), keeps the selectors existing Playwright specs rely on, keeps corner links, adds no per-frame loops, typecheck and build pass.
